description:
This PHP source file defines the Cache class within the ScssPhp
ode namespace. It manages caching functionality for SCSS processing, including storing, retrieving, and cleaning cache data based on specific options and conditions. The class includes methods for cache management such as getCache, setCache, cacheName, checkCacheDir, and cleanCache, and it relies on external entities like Version and standard PHP functions.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class for managing cache storage and retrieval for SCSS compilation, supporting versioning, cache invalidation, and cleanup based on lifetime.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache settings based on provided options, checking for mandatory cache directory and prefix.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a specific operation and content, considering cache validity based on last modification times and refresh policy.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores a result in cache for a particular operation and content, serializing data to files.

methods.name: cacheName
methods.description: Generates a unique cache filename using hashing based on operation, content, options, version, and prefix.

methods.name: checkCacheDir
methods.description: Validates that the cache directory exists and is writable.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Removes stale cache files based on their modification time and configured lifetime.
